query.text: exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join dmnh nh1 on a.nh_kh1 = nh1.ma_nh and nh1.ma_loai_nh = ''KH1'' left join dmnh nh2 on a.nh_kh2 = nh2.ma_nh and nh2.ma_loai_nh = ''KH2'' left join dmnh nh3 on a.nh_kh3 = nh3.ma_nh and nh3.ma_loai_nh = ''KH3''', 'nh1.ten_nh ten_nh_kh1, nh2.ten_nh ten_nh_kh2, nh3.ten_nh ten_nh_kh3, cast('''' as nvarchar(255)) as ma_plkh, cast('''' as nvarchar(255)) as ten_plkh', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright

declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = ''
if @ngay_goi2 >= @ngay_goi1 set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ngay_goi between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_goi1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_goi2, 112) + '''' if @ma_td <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_td like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_td) + '%''' if @ma_plkh <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_plkh like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_plkh) + '%''' if @ngay_goi_lai2 >= @ngay_goi_lai1 set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ngay_goi_lai between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_goi_lai1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_goi_lai2, 112) + ''''
if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from lslncuocgoi x where a.ma_so_thue = x.ma_so_thue ' + @strDetailKey + ')' set @strKey = @strFinding + @strDetailKey
exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join dmnh nh1 on a.nh_kh1 = nh1.ma_nh and nh1.ma_loai_nh = ''KH1'' left join dmnh nh2 on a.nh_kh2 = nh2.ma_nh and nh2.ma_loai_nh = ''KH2'' left join dmnh nh3 on a.nh_kh3 = nh3.ma_nh and nh3.ma_loai_nh = ''KH3''', 'nh1.ten_nh ten_nh_kh1, nh2.ten_nh ten_nh_kh2, nh3.ten_nh ten_nh_kh3, cast('''' as nvarchar(255)) as ma_plkh, cast('''' as nvarchar(255)) as ten_plkh', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId, 'SELECT ma_so_thue, a.ma_plkh, b.ten_plkh, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ma_so_thue ORDER BY line DESC) AS RowNum into #lslncuocgoi FROM lslncuocgoi a left join dmploaikh b on a.ma_plkh = b.ma_plkh where exists(select 1 from #v where ma_so_thue = a.ma_so_thue); UPDATE #v set ma_plkh = f.ma_plkh, ten_plkh = f.ten_plkh from #v a join #lslncuocgoi f on a.ma_so_thue = f.ma_so_thue DROP TABLE #lslncuocgoi'
